roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/billing-schedule/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo data, rearrange or drop sections, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Billing schedule block for a Billing settings page: next charge, a failed-payment notice, and every charge in a kit Table with its status as a word.
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Status is a word in a kit Badge (Upcoming, Paid, Failed…), never colour alone
Charges are a kit Table; do not build a local charges list
A failed payment is a kit Alert (danger) that says the date, the amount and what happens next
Money arrives pre-formatted from your app; label example data as example

Render inside a main landmark (wrap the pattern, or your page content, in <main>); header and nav chrome, if any, use AppHeader / SideNav (or other header / nav landmarks) and nav stays reachable on small screens
defaults: Section title "Billing schedule" with Download all as a ghost Button in its actions
Next-charge summary in a kit Card (size sm) with a vertical kit Divider between the amount and the date, above the table; nextOnly shows just the summary

summary is the overview card for a Billing page (the settings example uses it): no next-charge strip, the first `limit` charges (default 3) in two columns, charge with date and status, and amount, so it fits a half-width column, plus View all (ghost) via onViewAll
Update card is the one solid primary when a payment failed; Change card is outline
Loading uses Skeleton lines; empty uses a kit Empty; a load error uses a danger Alert and Retry
